description: Molar heat capacity parameters for hydrogen isotopologues. Ideal gas Cp(T) = a + b*T + c*T^2 [J/(mol·K)]. Liquid heat capacity approximation: Cp_L ≈ Cp_V * (1 + d/T).
source: Souers UCRL-52628 Table 2.1; NIST Webbook; estimated from corresponding states for less-characterized species

liquid_cp_correction_d.description: Liquid Cp ≈ Cp_V * (1 + d/T). The 'd' parameter captures the excess heat capacity of the liquid phase.

heat_of_vaporization_Tb.description: Latent heat at normal boiling point [J/mol]
